faces.name: Chance Encounter
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you win a coin flip, put a luck counter on this enchantment.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this enchantment has ten or more luck counters on it, you win the game.

faces.name: Chance for Glory
faces.oracleText: Creatures you control gain indestructible. Take an extra turn after this one. At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.

faces.name: Chancellor Gorkon
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
When Chancellor Gorkon dies, exile up to two target creatures.

faces.name: Chancellor of Tales
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever you cast an Adventure spell, you may copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

faces.name: Chancellor of the Annex
faces.oracleText:
You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, when each opponent casts their first spell of the game, counter that spell unless that player pays {1}.
Flying
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, counter it unless that player pays {1}.

faces.name: Chancellor of the Dross
faces.oracleText:
You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, at the beginning of the first upkeep, each opponent loses 3 life, then you gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Flying, lifelink

faces.name: Chancellor of the Forge
faces.oracleText:
You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, at the beginning of the first upkeep, create a 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature token with haste.
When this creature enters, create X 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste, where X is the number of creatures you control.

faces.name: Chancellor of the Mulligan
faces.oracleText:
You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, at the beginning of the first upkeep, shuffle it into your library and draw a card.
Menace
When Chancellor of the Mulligan enters the battlefield, draw three cards. When you do, any number of target players mulligan. (They shuffle their hand into their library, then draw that many cards and put one of them on the bottom of their library.)
